hindi: सामवायिकों द्वारा इस प्रकार आक्रमण किया गया विजिगीषु उनका जो प्रधान है, उससे कहे — “आपके साथ मेरी सन्धि है, यह धन है, और मैं मित्र हूँ, आपकी वृद्धि दुगुनी है। आप स्वयं के क्षय से मित्र के मुख वाले शत्रुओं को बढ़ाने के योग्य नहीं हैं; क्योंकि ये बढ़े हुए आपको ही पराभूत करेंगे।”
english: The conqueror, attacked in this way by the sāmavāyikas, should say to him who [is] the chief of them: “With you [is] my treaty; this [is] money, and I [am] an ally; your growth [is] twofold. You are not fit, by [your] own loss, to make enemies with the face of allies grow; for these, grown, will overpower you alone.”
notes: sāmavāyika (from sāmavāya 'union, combination') is kept as a term; it names the kings who have combined against the conqueror. sandhi = treaty (Book 7 convention). hiraṇya = money (glossary), 'gold' only in notes. tvayā is the instrumental of association ('with you'); 'by you' is the literal case. The copulas are supplied (bracketed in English). arhasi + infinitive = 'you are fit to'. paribhaviṣyanti (pari-√bhū) = overpower; 'humiliate, despise' are alternatives. ātma-kṣaya: ātman is the reflexive 'self', kṣaya = loss.

hindi: अथवा भेद कहे — “जैसे अपकार-रहित मैं इनके द्वारा मिलकर आक्रान्त हुआ, वैसे ये मिले हुए बल वाले स्वस्थ या व्यसन में आपको भी आक्रमण करेंगे; क्योंकि बल चित्त को बदलता है। इसलिए इनका विघात करो।”
english: Or [he] should say [words of] dissension: “As I, without offence, was attacked by these having combined, so also these, with united forces, [being] at ease or in calamity, will attack you also; for strength alters the mind. Therefore thwart these.”
notes: 'bhedaṃ brūyāt' is rendered literally ('should say dissension'); the sense is that he should speak words that cause dissension. anapakāra: bahuvrīhi 'without offence (done)', qualifying aham. svasthāḥ (nom. pl.) agrees with ete, so the attackers are 'at ease or in calamity'; a reading of the state as the victim's (tvām ... svastham vyasane vā) is possible. bala: 'strength' (alternative: force, army). 'tad eṣāṃ vighātaya': tat taken as 'therefore' and eṣām as a genitive object of vighāta-; alternative: 'thwart that (strength) of these'.

hindi: फूटे हुओं में प्रधान को सहारा देकर हीनों पर आक्रमण कराए, अथवा हीनों को अनुगृहीत करके प्रधान पर, अथवा जैसा श्रेयस्कर माने वैसा।
english: Among the split, having supported the chief, [he] should make [him] attack the weak; or, having favoured the weak, [he should make them attack] the chief; or as [he] may think the better, so [he should act].
notes: Subject and the elided verbs are supplied in brackets in English; Hindi leaves the elliptical clauses verbless. The locatives hīneṣu and pradhāne are the targets of vikramayet (caus. 'make attack', glossary). hīna is 'weak' (opposed to the chief). anugrāhya is read as an absolutive of the causative of anu-√grah. 'yathā vā śreyo 'bhimanyeta tathā' leaves the verb to be supplied.

hindi: अथवा दूसरों से वैर ग्रहण कराकर विसंवाद कराए।
english: Or, having caused enmity to be grasped by the others, [he] should cause [them] to disagree.
notes: grāhayitvā (caus. √grah) is rendered literally 'caused to be grasped' (glossary 9.6); the sense is probably 'made the others take up enmity'. visaṃvādayet: caus. of vi-sam-√vad, literally 'cause to be in disagreement'; 'cause a breach' is the likely sense. The object of visaṃvādayet is not stated.

hindi: अथवा फल की अधिकता से प्रधान को गुप्त रूप से उकसाकर सन्धि करवाए।
english: Or, having secretly instigated the chief by greater abundance of results, [he] should have a treaty made.
notes: phala = result (also 'fruit, profit'); bhūyastva = greater abundance. upajāpa = secret instigation (glossary). sandhi = treaty.

words.gram: pres. part. caus. √dṛś, m. nom. pl.

hindi: तब उभय-वेतन वाले, फल की अधिकता दिखाते हुए, सामवायिकों को “आप छले गए हैं” — दूषित करें।
english: Then those paid by both, showing abundance of results, should corrupt the sāmavāyikas, “You are outwitted.”

text_flags.why: possible typo: three d's; ity + ud-dūṣayeyuḥ gives two d's (ud + dūṣ), the third looks like a doubled consonant slip

notes: atha is rendered 'then' (alternative: 'now, if'). ubhaya-vetana = one paid by both (glossary 9.6). atisaṃhita = outwitted (glossary 8.5). The closing iti of the quoted words is carried by the quotation marks only. ud-√dūṣ (caus.) is rendered literally 'corrupt'; the sense is 'stir up, vitiate (their trust)'. The object sāmavāyikān is taken with uddūṣayeyuḥ; the quotation is the manner of corrupting.

hindi: बिगड़े हुओं में सन्धि को बिगाड़े।
english: Among the corrupted, [he] should spoil the treaty.
notes: duṣṭa = corrupted, spoiled (the sāmavāyikas whose trust was vitiated in the previous unit); 'when they are corrupted' is the sense of the locative. sandhi = treaty.

hindi: तब उभय-वेतन वाले फिर से इनका भेद करें — “इस प्रकार वह है जो हमारे द्वारा दिखाया गया।”
english: Then those paid by both should again make dissension of these: “[It is] in this way, that which was shown by us.”
notes: The quoted words are literal ('in this way — that which was shown by us'); the sense is 'it is as we showed'. eṣām genitive is rendered 'of these' (sense: among them). bhūyaḥ = again (also 'more').

hindi: फूटे हुओं में किसी एक को सहारा देने से चेष्टा करे।
english: Among the split, [he] should act by the support of any one.
notes: upagraha = supporting (cf. upagṛhya in unit 3). anyatama = any one of several. ceṣṭeta = should act, strive (alternative: should exert himself).

words.gloss: by gift of a girl and support
by favour of treasury and army

hindi: सामवायिकों के प्रधान के अभाव में उभारने वाले को, स्थिर कर्म वाले को, अनुरक्त प्रकृतियों वाले को, लोभ से या भय से संघात में आए हुए को, विजिगीषु से भयभीत को, राज्य से सम्बद्ध को, मित्र को या चंचल अमित्र को, उत्तर के अभाव में पूर्व वालों को साधे — उभारने वाले को आत्म-निसर्ग से, स्थिर कर्म वाले को सान्त्वना और प्रणाम से, अनुरक्त प्रकृतियों वाले को कन्या के दान और यापन से, लोभी को अंश की द्विगुणता से, इनसे भयभीत को कोश और सेना के अनुग्रह से, अपने से भयभीत को विश्वास दिलाकर प्रतिभू के प्रदान से, राज्य से सम्बद्ध को एकीभाव के उपगमन से, मित्र को दोनों ओर से प्रिय और हित से, अथवा उपकार के त्याग से, चंचल अमित्र को निश्चित करके अनपकार और उपकार से।
english: In the absence of the chief of the sāmavāyikas, [he] should win over the rouser, the one of steady action, the one of loyal constituent elements, the one come into the combination from greed or from fear, the one afraid of the conqueror, the one connected with the kingdom, an ally or a wavering enemy, the earlier ones in the absence of the later — the rouser by bestowal of self, the one of steady action by conciliation and prostration, the one of loyal constituent elements by the gift of a girl and by support, the greedy one by a twofold share, the one afraid of these by the favour of treasury and army, the one afraid from one's own [side], having made [him] trustful, by the giving of a surety, the one connected with the kingdom by approach to oneness, the ally on both sides by the agreeable and beneficial, or by giving up of help, the wavering enemy, ascertained, by non-injury and help.

text_flags.why: extra k: prakṛkti is not a word; the same compound is printed anurakta.prakṛtiṃ later in the unit

notes: Typo 'prakṛktiṃ' read prakṛtim; prakṛti = constituent element (glossary), though 'nature' is possible. utsāhayitṛ = rouser (cf. utsāhayati = rouse). The lone '-' is the e-text's dash between the list of persons and the list of means. 'pūrvān uttarābhāve' is rendered literally: the earlier-named ones (are to be won) in the absence of the later; the order of preference is not spelled out. sādhayet (caus. √sādh) with a person as object = win over. yāpana = support (literally 'causing to go on'); alternatives: maintenance, sending off; medium confidence. aṃśa-dvaiguṇya = twofold share. daṇḍa = army (prakṛti pair kośa-daṇḍa). svataḥ bhītam: 'afraid from one's own' (own side, or the conqueror's own self); sense uncertain. ekī-bhāva-upagamana = approach to the state of oneness. priya-hita kept literal (the agreeable and beneficial). upakāra-tyāga: giving up of help (given or claimed), uncertain. avadhṛta = ascertained (alternatives: determined, restrained); medium-low. cala-amitra read as a karmadhāraya 'wavering enemy'. The English list follows the Sanskrit accusatives governed by sādhayet; the correspondences between the first list and the second are by order.

words.gloss: by conciliation, gifts, dissension and force

hindi: अथवा जो यथायोग भजे, उसे उस प्रकार साधे, अथवा साम, दान, भेद, दण्ड से, जैसा आपत्तियों में हम व्याख्या करेंगे।
english: Or whoever may resort suitably, him [he] should win over in that way; or by conciliation, gifts, dissension and force, as we shall explain in adversities.

text_flags.why: possible typo: yathā + ayoga 'as non-connection' gives no sense; yathāyogam 'suitably, according to connection' fits tathā in the next clause

notes: The e-text's 'yathā-ayogaṃ' is read yathāyogam (possible over-split), 'suitably'; if ayoga were meant, the sense would be 'unfitness' and the clause obscure. bhajeta (√bhaj, middle) = would resort (to him), object not stated. The four upāyas: sāma, dāna, bheda, daṇḍa (force). yathā āpatsu = as (we shall explain) in the (chapter on) adversities. The first vā is rendered 'or', the second 'or by'.

hindi: अथवा व्यसन और उपघात से जल्दी में पड़ा हुआ कोश और सेना से, देश में, काल में या कार्य में निश्चित सन्धि को अपनाए।
english: Or, hurried by calamity and injury, [he] should adopt a treaty determined by treasury and army, in place, in time or in task.
notes: vyasana = calamity, upaghāta = injury (harm). avadhṛta = determined, fixed (alternative: restrained, limited); kośa-daṇḍābhyām (instrumental dual) could also be read 'with regard to treasury and army'. daṇḍa = army (prakṛti pair). sandhi = treaty. upeyāt = approach, 'adopt' as in 7.2.

hindi: जिसकी सन्धि हो चुकी है, हीन अपने-आप का प्रतिकार करे।
english: One whose treaty is made should remedy [his] deficient self.
notes: kṛta-sandhi is a bahuvrīhi 'whose treaty is made'; sandhi = treaty. hīna = deficient (in what is spelled out in the following units). pratikurvīta from prati-√kṛ, related to pratīkāra 'remedy'. ātmānam = self (never 'soul').

hindi: पक्ष में हीन बन्धुओं और मित्रों का पक्ष बनाए, अथवा दुर्ग को सामना न किए जाने योग्य।
english: One deficient in party should make a party of relatives and allies, or [make] the fort not to be withstood.
notes: pakṣa = party (supporters), not 'wing'. 'durgam aviṣahyaṃ vā' is read as 'or [make] the fort unassailable (not to be withstood)'; the verb is supplied. A reading 'make a fort that cannot be withstood' is possible. Hindi leaves the second alternative verbless.

words.gloss: propped up by fort and ally

hindi: क्योंकि दुर्ग और मित्र से टिका हुआ अपनों और दूसरों का पूज्य होता है।
english: For [one] propped up by fort and ally becomes to be honoured by [his] own and by the others.
notes: The genitives sveṣām pareṣām are agent genitives with the gerundive pūjya ('to be honoured by'). pratiṣṭabdha (prati-√stambh) = propped up, supported (alternative: made firm). pare = the others (glossary), not 'enemies'. The subject is the 'deficient in party' of the previous unit, supplied as '[one]'.

words.gloss: association with those advanced in learning

hindi: मन्त्र-शक्ति में हीन प्राज्ञ पुरुषों का संचय अथवा विद्या में वृद्धों का सम्पर्क करे।
english: One deficient in power of counsel should make an accumulation of wise men, or association with those advanced in learning.

text_flags.why: possible wrong anusvāra: samyoga for saṃyoga (the edition otherwise writes ṃ before y-type consonants)

notes: mantra-śakti = power of counsel (glossary). upacaya = accumulation (alternative: increase). vidyā-vṛddha = advanced in learning (elders in learning). saṃyoga = connection, association (glossary: never Hindi संयोग).

hindi: क्योंकि उस प्रकार तुरन्त श्रेय पाता है।
english: For in that way [he] obtains the better at once.
notes: śreyas = the better, the good (alternative: welfare). Subject supplied as '[he]'.

words.gloss: in success of acquisition and security of the constituent elements

hindi: प्रभाव में हीन प्रकृतियों के योग और क्षेम की सिद्धि में यत्न करे।
english: One deficient in might should strive in the success of the acquisition and security of the constituent elements.
notes: prabhāva = might (glossary 9.1); prakṛti = constituent element; yoga = acquisition and kṣema = security (glossary 6.2); siddhi = success. The locative with yateta is rendered literally ('strive in'); 'strive for' is the natural sense. The compound could also be grouped prakṛti-yoga-kṣema (of the constituents' acquisition and security).

hindi: जनपद सब कर्मों का स्रोत है; उससे प्रभाव।
english: The country [is] the source of all actions; from that, might.
notes: jana-pada = country (glossary). karma = action (glossary); 'undertakings' is the sense. yoni = source (literally womb). 'tataḥ prabhāvaḥ' is verbless ('from it, might').

hindi: उसका स्थान, और अपना आपत्ति में, दुर्ग है।
english: The fort [is] the place of that, and of oneself, in adversity.
notes: tasya refers to the country (jana-pada) of the previous unit. sthāna = place, station (alternative: standing, position). āpad = adversity (glossary).

hindi: सेतु-बन्ध फसलों का स्रोत है।
english: The embankment-dam [is] the source of crops.
notes: setu-bandha = embankment-dam (glossary 3.9), one item. sasya = crop, grain.

words.gloss: acquisition of the quality of rain

hindi: क्योंकि वर्षा के गुण का लाभ सेतुओं और बुआई में सदा जुड़ा हुआ है।
english: For the acquisition of the quality of rain [is] constantly connected in embankments and sowings.
notes: varṣa-guṇa-lābha: varṣa = rain (alternative: year), guṇa = quality (alternative: advantage); lābha = acquisition. anuṣakta = connected, attached, continuing. setu-vāpa read as a dvandva 'embankments and sowings' (alternative: sown fields with embankments). Low-medium certainty of the whole sense; rendered literally.

hindi: वणिक्-पथ दूसरे को छल लेने का स्रोत है।
english: The merchant-road [is] the source of outwitting the other.
notes: atisandhāna = outwitting (cf. atisandhā 'outwit', glossary); para = the other (glossary: not rendered 'enemy'). vaṇik-patha = merchant-road, trade route.

words.gloss: conveying across of army and secret agents
purchase of weapons, coverings, vehicles, conveyances

hindi: क्योंकि वणिक्-पथ से सेना और गूढ़ पुरुषों का पार ले जाना और शस्त्र, आवरण, यान, वाहन का क्रय किया जाता है; प्रवेश और निर्णयन।
english: For by the merchant-road are done the conveying across of army and secret agents and the purchase of weapons, coverings, vehicles and conveyances; entry and leading out [are done].
notes: daṇḍa = army, gūḍha-puruṣa = secret agent (glossary); the compound is read 'army and secret agents' (alternative: 'secret army-men'). āvaraṇa = covering (armour is the likely sense). yāna here = vehicle (as an object of purchase; not the Book 7 'march'); vāhana = conveyance, mount. nirṇayana (nir-√nī) = leading out (alternative: settlement, decision); medium. The verb kriyate is supplied for 'praveśo nirṇayanaṃ ca'. The singular kriyate agrees with the nearest subject.

words.gloss: of cattle, horses, donkeys and camels

hindi: खान युद्ध के उपकरणों का स्रोत है; द्रव्य-वन दुर्ग-कर्मों का और यान-रथों का; हस्ति-वन हाथियों का; और व्रज गाय-बैल, घोड़े, गधे, ऊँटों का।
english: A mine [is] the source of equipment of battle; a material-forest [is the source] of fort-works and of vehicles and chariots; an elephant-forest [is the source] of elephants; and a cattle-station [is the source] of cattle, horses, donkeys and camels.
notes: The predicate yoniḥ of the first clause is understood in the others. dravya-vana = a forest of materials (timber and the like); kept literal. durga-karman = works of forts (karma = work in lists of undertakings). yāna = vehicle here. vraja = cattle-station (glossary 9.6). gava = cattle (glossary 3.10).

words.gloss: from families of relatives and allies

hindi: उनकी अप्राप्ति में बन्धुओं और मित्रों के कुलों से एकत्र करना।
english: In the non-acquisition of these, [there is] collection from the families of relatives and allies.
notes: teṣām refers to the things listed in units 24-25 (equipment, materials, animals). samārjana (sam-ā-√ṛj) = collecting, procuring; no verb is stated.

words.gloss: of robber-bands, forest chiefs and mleccha kinds

hindi: उत्साह में हीन श्रेणियों के प्रवीर पुरुषों का, चोर-गण, आटविक, म्लेच्छ जातियों का, दूसरे का अपकार करने वालों का और गूढ़ पुरुषों का, लाभ के अनुसार संचय करे।
english: One deficient in energy should make an accumulation of brave men of guilds, of robber-bands, forest chiefs and mleccha kinds, of injurers of the other, and of secret agents, according to acquisition.

text_flags.why: doubled b: lābbha is not a word (yathālābham)

notes: utsāha = energy. The compound śreṇī-pravīra-puruṣa is read 'brave men of guilds' (alternative: guild troops and brave men). In the second compound jāti 'kind' may govern all members (robber-band kinds, forest-chief kinds, mleccha kinds). āṭavika = forest chief, mleccha kept as a name (glossary). para-apakārin = one who injures the other; para = the other. yathā-lābham = according to acquisition (as available). Typo 'lābbham' read lābham.

hindi: दूसरों में परमिश्र-अप्रतीकार अथवा आबलीयस का प्रयोग करे।
english: [He] should employ the para-miśra-apratīkāra or the ābalīyasa among the others.
notes: Obscure technical terms are kept untranslated. para-miśra (cf. para-miśrā in 9.6, kept as a name; literally 'mixed with the other') and apratīkāra ('remedy-less') may be two items run together or one phrase; the compound is doubtful. ābalīyasa is kept as in 3.x ('ābalīyasa yoga'), literally 'of the stronger'. pareṣu = among the others (not 'enemies').

hindi: इस प्रकार पक्ष से, मन्त्र से, द्रव्य से और बल से सम्पन्न होकर अपने पर दूसरे के अवग्रह के विरुद्ध निकले।
english: In this way, endowed with party, with counsel, both with material and with force, [he] should go out against the other's restraint of oneself.
notes: Verse (anuṣṭubh, 16 syllables per half-line). 'dravyeṇa ca balena ca' = 'both ... and' (Hindi has a single और). dravya = material (substance, resources); bala = force. avagraha = restraint (cf. avagrāhayet 'have restrained', glossary); ātmanaḥ is an objective genitive ('restraint of oneself'); the compound para-avagraha is read 'the other's restraint'. pratinirgacchet = go out against (alternative: go out in turn).
